note: Rue des Débardeurs place 2/5; landmark: tall wooden porters' hoist tower with a big pulley wheel lifting a pallet of crates. All six verbs are -er, so they are on the whitewashed houses on the left; the hoist tower stands on the right where the street goes on. Top margin extended a little so the roof-terrace man clears the 6% band. No -er/-ir markers, no painted text.
